• VIX volatility explosion: +8.56% to 26.64 (fear spike)
• Global selloff: Nikkei -2.38%, DAX -1.48%, Euro Stoxx -1.60%
• Volatility regime shifted to "explosive" with negative GEX at -58M
• Polymarket showing 29.5% recession odds, Fed cut probability near zero

**TRADE RECOMMENDATION STATUS:** EXIT

**TRADE NOTES:** Bull call spread is severely underwater with SPY likely opening near $650 (well below $655 long strike). Exit immediately at market open to preserve capital. Current spread likely worth <$1.00 vs $2.64 entry cost.

**DAY AHEAD RISKS:**
• Continued volatility expansion (VIX >26)
• Momentum selling into US open
• Negative GEX suggesting accelerated moves on volume
• Put wall at 630 could provide support, but significant downside to test

**DAY AHEAD OPPORTUNITIES:**
• Potential oversold bounce if selling exhausts early
• High volatility creates premium selling opportunities post-stabilization
• Watch for reversal signals near 630 put wall support level
